name: @khayt/design-system
description: Khayt's design language for the web — the Mac app's palette, type scale and card, as React components a design tool can render.

scripts.build: npm run tokens && node build-css.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:react --external:react-dom --external:react/jsx-runtime --outfile=dist/index.js
